alpha_eur_deposit_only: EUR supports deposits only. Use USD to withdraw.
alpha_eur_cash_help: Stays in € — IBKR converts only when buying if the USD cash balance is too low.
alpha_usd_cash_help: Negative means withdraw · no order can spend more than the allocated amount.
alpha_in_days: in {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
alpha_memory_help: Search for a ticker to see its history, or describe something in free text to find similar theses.
alpha_memory_placeholder: e.g. NVDA or “companies with an active tender offer”
alpha_memory_theses_history: {count, plural, one {# thesis · view history} other {# theses · view history}}
alpha_memory_excerpt_note: Saved excerpt (~550 characters: headline + start of the report) — not the full report.
alpha_audit_no_history: No history: {ticker} does not appear in any saved scan.
alpha_global_sync_unchanged: No changes since the last sync ({count} tickers); no duplicate copy was saved.
alpha_global_sync_error: Could not sync the global universe.
alpha_global_sync_running: Syncing in the background (~63,000 rows, a few minutes)…
alpha_global_csv_uploading: Uploading {filename} and syncing in the background…
alpha_global_not_synced: The global universe (Hugging Face) has not been synced yet — without it, there are no names to choose from.
alpha_global_capture_cut: Global capture stopped early: {reason} ({captured}/{requested} names captured anyway).
alpha_global_capture_done: Global capture finished: {captured}/{requested} names captured ({missing} without data).
alpha_global_capture_started: Global capture started ({count} names, ~{minutes} min in the background).
alpha_global_resync_first: The global universe (Hugging Face) has not been synced yet — sync it from “Global universe” first.
alpha_global_filter_help: Without a country or market filter, prices, market cap, and volume are not fetched (the global dataset does not include them) — a limit is always required.
alpha_global_capture_help: Filters by country and market only, not price, market cap, or volume.
alpha_scan_a_fondo_ayuda: full report from the reasoning model
alpha_scan_finalistas_ayuda: highest scores, sent to the builder
alpha_scan_emergencia_ayuda: NASDAQ did not respond and no closing snapshot was available
alpha_scan_vivo_ayuda: No closing snapshot: the universe is reduced while the market is open
alpha_scan_suelo: · {count} met the liquidity floor; the highest-volume companies are scanned
alpha_scan_config_saved_help: Saved for use by the monthly cron and the “Analyze and decide” button.
alpha_scan_config_observatory_help: Applied to the next observatory run launched from the card.
alpha_cost_estimated_tooltip: Estimate based on the tokens in each response.
alpha_scan_data_issues: {noData} without data · {prescoreErrors} pre-score failures · {deepErrors} unreadable deep reports
alpha_explorer_help: Filter previously captured fundamentals snapshots. There is no scan target; this is for exploring the market only. Nothing is saved.
alpha_filter_options_unavailable: Sector, country, and market filters are unavailable; the rest of the filters still work.
alpha_near_high_help: Exclude stocks more than this percentage below their 52-week high. For example, 10 means within 10% of the high.
alpha_snapshot_range_help: Blank = each ticker’s latest snapshot, regardless of date. With dates, use each ticker’s latest snapshot within that range to inspect the market at a past point in time.
alpha_snapshot_latest_hint: no dates = each ticker’s latest snapshot
alpha_header_description: The agent proposes trades; each order waits for your yes or no.
alpha_working_order_help: Live limit order at IBKR (valid for the session). The ledger reconciles when it fills; its cash and shares are reserved, so they cannot be spent twice.
alpha_expire_days: Expire after {count} days without a decision
alpha_get_started_help: Two steps. The agent proposes; each order waits for your yes or no. {dryRun, select, dry {It is currently in simulation, so nothing reaches IBKR.} live {} other {}}
alpha_monthly_scan_explainer: The agent scans after the close on the last trading day of each month, at 4:45 p.m. US market time, and decides on the portfolio (shadow ledger and proposals here). You can also run it now with “Analyze market.”
alpha_analytics_help: Funnel stage costs and prescore confidence, queried from a local DuckDB file synced daily from Postgres.
alpha_ready_cash_help: Cash is ready: $ {cashUsd} + € {cashEur}. Once you approve a proposed buy, the position will appear here with its allocation, cost, and live P&L.
alpha_contributions_not_return: Contributions do not count as returns
alpha_personal_portfolio_empty: Your own IBKR positions, separate from the agent. Sync to save a snapshot.
alpha_ibkr_eurusd_tooltip: At the indicative EUR/USD exchange rate, as consolidated by IBKR.
alpha_last_sync_price_tooltip: Price from the last sync (not a live quote).
alpha_personal_portfolio_help: The agent never trades these positions; it only sells shares it bought. If it buys one of your tickers, IBKR combines them, but they remain separate here.
alpha_push_help: Alerts sound when the agent makes a proposal. On iPhone, install the app on your Home Screen.
alpha_never_auto_executes: the agent never executes on its own
alpha_shadow_reset_help: Resetting the shadow ledger deletes positions, trades, and the curve, but keeps your capital. It does not affect the live ledger or your personal portfolio.
